messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Buspirone is not an anti-psychotic medication and should not be used in place of medication prescribed by your doctor for psychotic disorders.

In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

B. 'has effect': The subject drug produces the therapeutic or physiological effect specified by the object entity.
C. 'has mechanism of action': The subject drug produces its therapeutic effect through the biological mechanism specified by the object entity.
D. 'used in': The subject drug is utilized in the medical procedure or clinical context specified by the object entity.
